key_takeaway: The multi-currency listings Guesty promised but never delivered are a live, working feature in Boom — alongside a full AI layer, and a 10-minute API migration that makes the switch the easy path, not the hard one.
summary_bullets: Your dealbreaker with Guesty — multi-currency listings (AUD/USD on Airbnb, IDR on Booking.com & Agoda, USD on Vrbo) — is fully supported in Boom today. Two clients switched from Guesty specifically for it; a technical video is on the way.

You called Guesty's AI 'mind-blowingly failing.' Boom's AI actually runs the work — guest comms across every channel, auto-created service calls with photos, homeowner and cleaner agents, and multi-language translation both ways in real time.

Because you're on Guesty, migration is the easy case — Boom pulls all your property data with an API key in about 10 minutes, and reads your existing Guesty communication history to pre-build your policies, so onboarding is ~80% less work than a cold migration.
executive_summary: Idan walked Enny, Putra and Jio through a full Boom platform demo after two frustrating months onboarding with Guesty. The team's decision to move is driven by a breach of trust — Guesty's sales team promised multi-currency listings that don't exist — plus an AI that hasn't delivered. Boom confirmed multi-currency is live today, showed its AI running real operational work end-to-end, and framed the Guesty-to-Boom switch as the easy migration path. Next: a reference call with a Mexico-based ex-Guesty client, follow-up videos on multi-currency and push sync, and Janine's sign-off on pricing already honored from two months ago.

discussion_points.title: Why 5 Star Bali is leaving Guesty
items: Multi-currency listings were promised by Guesty's sales team but the feature doesn't exist — the core breach of trust and the dealbreaker.
Guesty's AI is not delivering ('mind-blowingly failing') and only covers guest support — nothing for homeowners or contractors.
Onboarding felt overwhelming and overly complex for a team new to a PMS, with many features (like accounting) they'll never use since they run on Xero.

discussion_points.title: How Boom solves it
items: Multi-currency is a live, current feature — confirmed, with a technical video to follow.
AI runs across all segments: guests, homeowners, cleaners and contractors, with adaptive tone, auto service-calls from guest messages, and two-way live translation.
Easy Guesty migration — API key pulls all data in ~10 minutes and pre-builds guest-comms policies from your existing Guesty history.
One-stop platform: multi-calendar, ops, CRM, dynamic pricing, guest portal, website builder and owner dashboards — no third-party integrations needed.

discussion_points.title: Where Boom takes them next
items: BIM (Boom's AI assistant) gives Janine a daily automated CEO briefing — review-risk guests, best/worst listings, contractor and cleaner performance — without touching the PMS.
The Optimizer scans the portfolio daily for revenue, distribution and operations fixes with one-click execution to the OTAs.
Fully customizable owner portal + mobile app with P&L, expenses and photo-documented maintenance — owners can be shown or hidden any detail (e.g. hide the booking channel, show the commission calc).

discussion_points.title: Agreements & next steps
items: Boom will honor the pricing offered to Janine two months ago.
